title: Flatness of degree-zero opcycles of a bounded-above free model
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $d$ a natural number, and $C^\bullet,Q^\bullet$ cochain complexes of structure-sheaf modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Assume $C^n=0$ for $n<0$ and $n>d$, $Q^n=0$ for $n>d$, each $C^n$ is flat over the identity of $X$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], and for every integer $n$ there is a natural number $r_n$ and an isomorphism $Q^n\cong\mathcal O_X^{r_n}$. Let $e:Q^\bullet\to C^\bullet$ be a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Then the actual cokernel $Q^0/\operatorname{im}(Q^{-1}\to Q^0)$ is flat over the identity of $X$.

source.place: Tag 0653, label lemma-last-one-flat, applied at every stalk; affine localization comparisons are Tags 01U4 and 00HT. Source text checked on the Stacks website; the local source checkout is absent.

proof.text: For each stalk, use flat_stalk_of_affineFlatOver_identity to obtain flatness of every C term. A canonical free sheaf is a coproduct of the monoidal unit, so the proved source ObjectProperty.flat_coproduct gives its tensor flatness. flat_stalk_of_isFlat gives its stalk flatness; transport through the supplied finite-free isomorphisms to obtain flatness of each Q term.

module_stalk_exact carries exact short complexes to exact short complexes. Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact therefore gives preservation of homology; the moduleStalkFunctor also preserves zero morphisms. Mathlib then transports e as a quasi-isomorphism and transports all three strict bounds to the stalk complexes.

In the private proved helper module_opcycles_flat, install the standard derived category of ModuleCat and the exact integer-indexed colimit instance. Convert Module.Flat to ObjectProperty.flat by the proved source ModuleCat.flat_iff_flat. The proved source DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn_Q_obj_of_flat gives Tor amplitude [0,d] for C. CochainComplex.kFlat_of_isStrictlyLE_of_flat gives categorical K-flatness of Q. The quasi-isomorphism e induces a derived isomorphism E; tensor E with N[0] and compose with the proved source DerivedCategory.QObjTensorSingleFunctorObjIso. This makes the ordinary Q tensor N complex IsGE 0, hence ExactAt (-1). Apply the already proved source ObjectProperty.flat_opcycles_of_exactAt and convert back by ModuleCat.flat_iff_flat. These are applications of existing proved generic source theorems; no one-point-site conversion or new theorem with sorry is used.

ShortComplex.mapOpcyclesIso for the exact stalk functor identifies the opcycles of the stalk complex with the stalk of Q.opcycles 0. Transfer flatness through that linear equivalence. The supplied finite-free isomorphisms make Q^(-1) and Q^0 quasi-coherent. Use isQuasicoherent_cokernel and the canonical opcycles-to-cokernel isomorphism to make Q.opcycles 0 quasi-coherent.

The private proved helper affine_sections_flat_of_flat_stalks evaluates a maximal ideal P of the affine coordinate ring at the corresponding point x. IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk identifies O_x as the localization at P. The tensor module O_x tensor G(U) is a localization presentation by Mathlib tensorProduct_isLocalizedModule. affine_sections_stalk_tensor_presentation identifies it with G_x, so flatness of G_x and flatness of the localization ring give flatness over O(U). Module.flat_of_isLocalized_maximal makes G(U) flat. Finally the identity scheme morphism is flat, so its affine appLE rings are flat; Module.Flat.trans gives flatness of G(U) over O(V) for every affine pair U contained in V, exactly IsFlatOver. Empty opens and the zero ring require no points or additional assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem isFlatOver_opcycles_zero_of_quasiIso {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (C Q : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hCge : C.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hCle : C.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hCflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 X))
    (hQle : Q.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hQfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ,
      Nonempty (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
    (e : Q ⟶ C) (he : QuasiIso e) :
    (Q.opcycles 0).IsFlatOver (𝟙 X)
